# ADO703: script-linter-unavailable

ShellCheck or PSScriptAnalyzer isn't installed, so scripts weren't linted.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Scripts |
| **Default severity** | info |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | script linting, when a linter can't be run |

## Description

Script linters run from PATH and aren't bundled. With --require-script-linters, a missing tool is an error and adolint exits with code 2.

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO703: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO703` or `--enable ADO703`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO703
```
